description: Machine-readable, model-independent definition of the complete 96-prompt T2M diagnostic benchmark. The team-revised 18-prompt Pilot selection from pilot_benchmark_definition_model_independent_v1.2 is preserved exactly; the remaining 78 prompts are Main. Full catalogue prompt text and atomic targets are transcribed from Appendix A of the supplied T2M-Benchmark specification. Motion generation length is determined by each source model rather than prescribed by this definition.

difficulty_definition.principle: Difficulty reflects overall instruction-execution complexity, not simply the number of atomic requirements.

levels.Easy: Single basic action with simple control and no complex event relationships.
levels.Medium: Additional control demands or simple multi-event structure, such as body-side control, attributes, moderate counting, or two-event ordering.
levels.Hard: Advanced execution demands such as higher counting, cross-body relations, simultaneity, or multi-action composition.

difficulty_definition.note: Atomic requirement count may contribute to complexity, but it does not determine difficulty by itself.
